leadText: Volume 10 is the tenth and final volume of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.
plainText:
Volume 10 is the tenth and final volume of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga created by Yumi Tsukirino.

==Blurb==
The concluding volume to the love escapades of our protagonists! Will Hazel ever win over Almond's affections? Will Coconut bow out without a fight? What will happen when Apricot and Walnut discover each other's true identities? And what lies ahead for their Pokémon friends? All shall be revealed! Don't miss out!

==Publications==
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Hazel VS Almond!
Coconut's Love Waltz (Part 1)
Coconut's Love Waltz (Part 2)
Apricot and Wal
Chikorita's Merry Christmas
The Last Spell (Part 1)
The Last Spell (Part 2)
True Identities
Heart-Thumping Cookies
The Miraculous Color of the Sky ~Best Friends~
Those Were The Days

==Important events==
 
Hazel and Almond both enter a Contest held by Grandpa. Almond wins a Star Piece, giving it to Hazel.
Kiaraway is introduced.
Kiaraway steals Coconut's first kiss.
Chiko reveals her feelings to .
Hazel and Almond meet the legendary Pokémon and .
Hazel and Almond become a couple.
Apricot and Walnut discover each other's true identities and go out on a date.
and are reincarnated as a little girl and a and become friends again in their new lives.

==Trivia==
The Chuang Yi translation of this volume was released on the same day as VIZ Media's second edition of of Pokémon Adventures.
